title: Ascension quest
summary: Reforge a supported original class epic.
body:
Paladins receive Ascended Fiery Defender from their epic quest; see the free exchange for existing Defenders below. Other supported class epics use the paid recipe described here.

  • Start: Epic Forgemaster, in the tunnel’s tradeskill workshop.
  • Bring: Your supported class epic, unequipped in inventory, plus exactly 8 Essence of Ascension and 100,000 platinum.
  • Finish: Hand in the essence and platinum together. The forge consumes the original epic and grants its Ascended version.
  • Know before you go: Eligibility uses your starting class, not your extra classes. It supports thirteen other original class-epic weapon sets, excluding Paladin, Beastlord and Berserker. If a Ranger carries both supported epics, both are reforged. You must already have the epic and materials; this does not provide the original epic quest.

See the tunnel guide for services and travel options for your next destination.

This update is in Change Log →

Paladin epic — direct Ascended reward

Live testing: the Paladin epic quest awards Ascended Fiery Defender directly, without an extra essence or platinum requirement. Existing normal Defender owners can place the sword in a top-level inventory slot and say ascend fiery defender to the Epic Forgemaster for a free exchange preserving grip, augments, charges, binding, color and ornaments. Do not hand over the sword or payment. Other classes keep the paid recipe described above. New quest rewards start in 2HS; exchanged weapons keep their grip. Weapon stats and grip instructions.
